name: images-tools
description: Resize, compress, round the corners of and convert images right on Jensen's image page, with a Rust backend that agents can call too
author: Jensen

scripts.test: bun test test && cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml

jensen.backendBuild: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && cp backend/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/images_tools.wasm backend.wasm

tools.name: info
tools.description: Read an image's format, pixel size and file size without changing it. Works on png, jpeg, gif, webp, bmp, ico, tiff and svg.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

tools.name: resize
tools.description: Resize an image in place. Give a width, a height, or both. With both and keepAspect (the default) the image fits inside that box. SVG is redrawn sharp at the new size as a PNG next to the original.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

out.description: Write the result here instead of next to the source

tools.name: compress
tools.description: Make an image file smaller without changing its pixel size. JPEG uses quality, PNG is recompressed losslessly (and stored as a palette when it has 256 colors or fewer), SVG is minified. The file is left alone when it cannot get smaller.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

out.description: Write the result here instead of next to the source

tools.name: round_corners
tools.description: Round an image's corners with smooth, transparent edges. radius is in pixels, or a percent of the shortest side when percent is true (50 makes a circle). A JPEG becomes a PNG because it cannot be transparent.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

out.description: Write the result here instead of next to the source

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an image to another format and replace the original with the new file, which has the new extension. Targets: png, jpg, webp (lossless), gif, bmp, ico (256 px or smaller), tiff. SVG is drawn as a raster and the SVG is kept. Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless overwrite is true.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

width.description: For SVG sources: the raster width

out.description: Write the result here instead of next to the source
